mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_compressions (object_key, group_code, source, outcome, tier, quality, max_long_edge, original_bytes, compressed_bytes, compressed_at) VALUES (#{record.objectKey}, #{record.groupCode}, #{record.source}, #{record.outcome}, #{record.tier}, #{record.quality}, #{record.maxLongEdge}, #{record.originalBytes}, #{record.compressedBytes}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (object_key) DO UPDATE SET group_code = EXCLUDED.group_code, source = EXCLUDED.source, outcome = EXCLUDED.outcome, tier = EXCLUDED.tier, quality = EXCLUDED.quality, max_long_edge = EXCLUDED.max_long_edge, original_bytes = EXCLUDED.original_bytes, compressed_bytes = EXCLUDED.compressed_bytes, compressed_at = EXCLUDED.compressed_at
mapper.select: SELECT group_code, outcome, COUNT(*) AS image_count, COALESCE(SUM(original_bytes), 0) AS original_bytes, COALESCE(SUM(compressed_bytes), 0) AS compressed_bytes FROM image_compressions GROUP BY group_code, outcome
